We have two subnetworks: subnet1 (A to X1 via N1,N2) with resistors R1,R2,R3 values given. Subnet2 (B to X1 via N_b1 etc) with resistors R4,R5,R6,R7.

We need combine all subnetworks to form complete network topology. The measurements list includes many node pairs, including between A and B, A and N_b1, etc. The combined topology we used (just connecting the two subnetworks at X1) gave simulated resistances matching measurements: A-B 66.363 vs measurement 66.364 (close), A-X1 16.363 vs 16.364 (close). Need also check other measurements like A-N_b1 etc. Let's simulate a few more to ensure consistency.
